$comment: Reviewed spawn census of the navigation build (docs/research/terrain-navigation.md §12; D-030, RC-02, RC-05). Components are
identified by map and anchor (the lowest kind, id and spawn index among the spawns in them), never by component index.
First review, 3b.4 (build 1.60.1.70009, settings c05r1+n12+e5+s60, QuestieDB b6f5b07). Entries whose note starts with
'reviewed:' were examined individually (the island, Rut'theran, Thunder Bluff, the Ban'ethil Barrow Den chamber of RC-02,
the G7 floors and the zones). The others were drafted by tools/terrain/review-draft.ts from measured facts with the rules
in its header (note 'rule:'); they are geometric descriptions, not in-game checks. The gate fails on an unreviewed
component or unsnapped spawn, on a reviewed component growing by more than 10%, and on a zone of 50 or more spawns keeping
less than 90% (or its minShare) in its dominant component. Regenerate a draft with pnpm nav:review-draft.
